key: Until the sleeping spell on Agate City is removed, no one may enter or pass through. This is for your own safety.
en: Until the sleeping spell on Agate City is removed, no one may enter or pass through. This is for your own safety.
ja: アゲートシティの眠りの呪いが解けるまで、誰も立ち入り・通行はできません。皆様の安全のためです。

key: Your challenge is assigned as such--
en: Your challenge is assigned as such--
ja: お前への試練はこうだ――

key: A Pokémon that shocks on touch,
en: A Pokémon that shocks on touch,
ja: 触れれば感電するポケモン、

key: And through no Ability or such old hat,
en: And through no Ability or such old hat,
ja: 特性でも古い技でもなく、

key: On whom Elec-moves always fall flat.
en: On whom Elec-moves always fall flat.
ja: でんきわざはいつも通じない。

key: ...Alas, the mark is not before our eyes.
en: ...Alas, the mark is not before our eyes.
ja: ……ああ、その相手は目の前にはいないようだ。

key: And so you shall receive no prize!
en: And so you shall receive no prize!
ja: ゆえに、褒美はなしとしよう!

key: Correct! Upon you, the fox doth smile!
en: Correct! Upon you, the fox doth smile!
ja: 正解! お前にキツネの微笑みあり!

key: Now let it join you for a while!
en: Now let it join you for a while!
ja: しばしこの子を連れていくがいい!

key: \PN traded Stunfisk for Vulpix!
en: \PN traded Stunfisk for Vulpix!
ja: \PNはマッギョとロコンを交換した!

key: Trainer, friend, from worlds beyond!
en: Trainer, friend, from worlds beyond!
ja: 旅人よ、友よ、遠き世界より来たりし者!

key: Stay and listen to my song!
en: Stay and listen to my song!
ja: しばし留まり、我が歌に耳を傾けよ!

key: A vivid and exciting tale,
en: A vivid and exciting tale,
ja: 鮮やかで胸躍る物語、

key: That will amuse you without fail!
en: That will amuse you without fail!
ja: 必ずやお前を楽しませることだろう!

key: A riddle starts our verse today:
en: A riddle starts our verse today:
ja: 今日の一節は謎かけより始まる:

key: Pray tell, what doth the fox say?
en: Pray tell, what doth the fox say?
ja: 問おう、キツネは何と言う?

key: The fox bequeaths its regal might
en: The fox bequeaths its regal might
ja: キツネはその気高き力を授ける

key: Upon Trainers who supply it right--
en: Upon Trainers who supply it right--
ja: 正しき供物をささげしトレーナーに――

key: A Pokémon's your answer's form!
en: A Pokémon's your answer's form!
ja: 答えはポケモンの姿をしている!

key: So go! And take the fox by storm!
en: So go! And take the fox by storm!
ja: さあ行け! キツネを勢いよく連れて帰るがいい!

key: And through no talent or such old hat,
en: And through no talent or such old hat,
ja: 才能でも古い技でもなく、

key: You need not fear your fate again;
en: You need not fear your fate again;
ja: もはや己の運命を恐れる必要はない;

key: The fox will see you to your end.
en: The fox will see you to your end.
ja: キツネがお前を最後まで見届けよう。

key: I came down here from Calcenon, but man, it's such a long way back, I kinda don't wanna go...
en: I came down here from Calcenon, but man, it's such a long way back, I kinda don't wanna go...
ja: カルセノンからここまで降りてきたけど、戻るのが長すぎて、正直行きたくないなあ……

key: The snacks here are tasty, but I wish I could go home and cook...
en: The snacks here are tasty, but I wish I could go home and cook...
ja: ここのおやつは美味しいけど、家に帰って料理したいなあ……

key: Route 2 is tricky to navigate. Look out for some places where you can jump to nearby ledges!
en: Route 2 is tricky to navigate. Look out for some places where you can jump to nearby ledges!
ja: 2番道路は進むのが厄介だぞ。近くの段差に飛び移れる場所を探すといい!

key: There are two kinds of plants on Route 2:
en: There are two kinds of plants on Route 2:
ja: 2番道路には二種類の植物がある:

key: Sleep Powder plants and Rage Powder plants.
en: Sleep Powder plants and Rage Powder plants.
ja: ねむりごなの植物と、いかりのこなの植物だ。

key: They're just like the attacks Pokémon use!
en: They're just like the attacks Pokémon use!
ja: ポケモンが使うわざとまったく同じ効果だぞ!

key: If any Crustle get in your way, either put 'em to sleep, or rile 'em up and KO them!
en: If any Crustle get in your way, either put 'em to sleep, or rile 'em up and KO them!
ja: イワパレスが邪魔をしてきたら、眠らせるか、怒らせて倒しちまえ!

key: Also, if one of them is totally unresponsive, try Rage Powder for that too!
en: Also, if one of them is totally unresponsive, try Rage Powder for that too!
ja: それと、まったく反応しないやつがいたら、それにもいかりのこなを試してみるといい!

key: Throwing Sleep Powder on a wild Pokémon-- you can guess what happens.
en: Throwing Sleep Powder on a wild Pokémon-- you can guess what happens.
ja: 野生のポケモンにねむりごなを投げたら――どうなるかは分かるだろ。

key: But Rage Powder will wake up sleeping Pokémon and make them attack!
en: But Rage Powder will wake up sleeping Pokémon and make them attack!
ja: でも、いかりのこなは眠ってるポケモンを起こして、攻撃させてしまうんだ!

key: Shoot! I sprained my ankle jumping across the wild Crustle here!
en: Shoot! I sprained my ankle jumping across the wild Crustle here!
ja: しまった! ここの野生のイワパレスを飛び越えようとして、足首をひねっちまった!

key: Haha... Well, I guess that's what I get for shoving it into a hole in order to get across, huh?
en: Haha... Well, I guess that's what I get for shoving it into a hole in order to get across, huh?
ja: はは……渡るためにあいつを穴に押し込んだ罰なのかもな。

key: Careful crossing Route 2!
en: Careful crossing Route 2!
ja: 2番道路を渡る時は気をつけろよ!

key: Some stones you can jump on aren't stable!
en: Some stones you can jump on aren't stable!
ja: 飛び乗れる石の中には、不安定なものもあるんだ!

key: They'll spoil any powder you're holding, but some people have even fallen!
en: They'll spoil any powder you're holding, but some people have even fallen!
ja: 持ってる粉をダメにするだけならまだしも、落っこちた人もいるくらいだぞ!

key: Try your best to avoid unstable rocks, all right?
en: Try your best to avoid unstable rocks, all right?
ja: できるだけ不安定な石は避けるようにな、いいか?

key: Now at: Agate Circus
en: Now at: Agate Circus
ja: 現在地: アゲートサーカス

key: Now at: Route 2.
en: Now at: Route 2.
ja: 現在地: 2番道路。

key: Route 2 is ahead, but you might need a Powder Vial to get through it!
en: Route 2 is ahead, but you might need a Powder Vial to get through it!
ja: この先は2番道路だが、通り抜けるにはこなのビンが必要かもしれないぞ!

key: The Powder Vial collects and stores various spores from large plants in Route 2.
en: The Powder Vial collects and stores various spores from large plants in Route 2.
ja: こなのビンは、2番道路の大きな植物から出る様々な胞子を集めて保存できるんだ。

key: It can hold one use of two types of powder: Sleep Powder and Rage Powder.
en: It can hold one use of two types of powder: Sleep Powder and Rage Powder.
ja: ねむりごなといかりのこな、二種類の粉をそれぞれ1回分ずつ入れておける。

key: Route 2 is a rocky road, so you'll probably need those powders to help you cross.
en: Route 2 is a rocky road, so you'll probably need those powders to help you cross.
ja: 2番道路は岩だらけだから、渡るにはその粉の力が必要になるだろう。

key: The Pokémon will be happy to help!
en: The Pokémon will be happy to help!
ja: ポケモンたちも喜んで手を貸してくれるぞ!

key: ...With some peaceful coercion.
en: ...With some peaceful coercion.
ja: ……多少、穏やかな強制にはなるがな。

key: However, there's one flaw:
en: However, there's one flaw:
ja: ただし、ひとつ欠点がある:

key: When carrying contained powder, be sure not to shake it too much, or it will spoil!
en: When carrying contained powder, be sure not to shake it too much, or it will spoil!
ja: 粉を入れたまま持ち運ぶときは、あまり揺らさないように気をつけろ、ダメになっちまうからな!

key: As such, try to avoid stepping anywhere with unstable footing.
en: As such, try to avoid stepping anywhere with unstable footing.
ja: だから、足場が不安定な場所には極力足を踏み入れないようにな。

key: Ask me again if you need a refresh, got it?
en: Ask me again if you need a refresh, got it?
ja: もう一度聞きたくなったら、また声をかけてくれ、いいな?

key: Please stay calm; it is still not safe to enter the city.
en: Please stay calm; it is still not safe to enter the city.
ja: どうか落ち着いてください、街への立ち入りはまだ安全ではありません。

key: Agate City is safe for now.
en: Agate City is safe for now.
ja: アゲートシティは今のところ安全です。

key: Please report to us immediately if you find anything suspicious within it.
en: Please report to us immediately if you find anything suspicious within it.
ja: 不審なものを見つけた場合は、すぐにご報告ください。

key: Hey... I lost my parents when Agate City was shut down and now I'm all alone with no one to take care of me...
en: Hey... I lost my parents when Agate City was shut down and now I'm all alone with no one to take care of me...
ja: ねえ……アゲートシティが封鎖された時に両親とはぐれちゃって、今はもう誰にも面倒見てもらえないひとりぼっちなんだ……

key: It's making me really sad, so do you think you could cheer me up by going to get me some cotton candy?
en: It's making me really sad, so do you think you could cheer me up by going to get me some cotton candy?
ja: すごく悲しくてさ、綿菓子を買ってきて元気づけてくれないかな?

key: Is that it? Did you bring that Cotton Candy for me?!
en: Is that it? Did you bring that Cotton Candy for me?!
ja: それって、あたしのために持ってきてくれた綿菓子?!

key: \PN handed over the Cotton Candy.
en: \PN handed over the Cotton Candy.
ja: \PNは綿菓子を渡した。

key: Wow! Thank you, you're the best! I feel a lot less sad about the untimely demise of my parents now!
en: Wow! Thank you, you're the best! I feel a lot less sad about the untimely demise of my parents now!
ja: わあ! ありがとう、最高だよ! 両親を突然失った悲しみが、だいぶ和らいだ気がする!

key: ...But I'm still kinda sad.
en: ...But I'm still kinda sad.
ja: ……でも、まだちょっと悲しいかな。

key: You know what would make me less sad? A balloon! Balloons really lift the spirits up! Would you go get me a balloon?!
en: You know what would make me less sad? A balloon!  Balloons really lift the spirits up! Would you go get me a balloon?!
ja: 何があればもっと元気になれるか分かる? 風船だよ! 風船って気分を盛り上げてくれるんだから! 取ってきてくれない?!

key: Huh? Oh, okay... I'll just go back to being really lonely and sad over here, all alone... with no cotton candy...
en: Huh? Oh, okay... I'll just go back to being really lonely and sad over here, all alone... with no cotton candy...
ja: え? ああ、そう……じゃあまたひとりで寂しく悲しくしてるよ……綿菓子もないままで……

key: Hey... I lost my parents when Agate City was shutdown and now I'm all alone with no one to take care of me...
en: Hey... I lost my parents when Agate City was shutdown and now I'm all alone with no one to take care of me...
ja: ねえ……アゲートシティが封鎖された時に両親とはぐれちゃって、今はもう誰にも面倒見てもらえないひとりぼっちなんだ……

key: It's making me really sad so do you think you could cheer me up by going to get me some cotton candy?
en: It's making me really sad so do you think you could cheer me up by going to get me some cotton candy?
ja: すごく悲しくてさ、綿菓子を買ってきて元気づけてくれないかな?

key: Wow, is that Air Balloon for me?!
en: Wow, is that Air Balloon for me?!
ja: わあ、その風船、あたしにくれるの?!

key: \PN handed over the Air Balloon.
en: \PN handed over the Air Balloon.
ja: \PNは風船を渡した。

key: Oh my god, really? You're so cool! Yay, this balloon is the funnest!
en: Oh my god, really? You're so cool! Yay, this balloon is the funnest!
ja: うそ、マジで?! あんた最高だね! やった、この風船めっちゃ楽しい!

key: It almost makes me forget all about how I'll never see my parents or any of my family ever again!
en: It almost makes me forget all about how I'll never see my parents or any of my family ever again!
ja: もう二度と両親にも家族にも会えないってこと、ほとんど忘れられちゃいそう!

key: Oh... Now I'm thinking about that. I feel really lonely...
en: Oh... Now I'm thinking about that. I feel really lonely...
ja: あ……そのこと考えちゃった。すごく寂しくなってきた……

key: Hey! You know what might make me less lonely?
en: Hey! You know what might make me less lonely?
ja: ねえ! 何があれば寂しくなくなるか分かる?

key: If you brought me a Poké Doll from the High Striker! I know I couldn't win it, but you could, and that would stop me from crying myself to sleep every night!
en: If you brought me a Poké Doll from the High Striker! I know I couldn't win it, but you could, and that would stop me from crying myself to sleep every night!
ja: ハイストライカーのポケモンのぬいぐるみだよ! あたしじゃ取れないけど、あんたなら取れるでしょ、そしたら毎晩泣きながら寝るのも終わりになるのに!

key: Oh... That's okay, I understand. I'll just be here, spirits deflating like a six-day-old balloon... forgotten... neglected...
en: Oh... That's okay, I understand. I'll just be here, spirits deflating like a six-day-old balloon... forgotten...  neglected...
ja: あ……いいよ、分かってるから。ここでこのまま、六日経った風船みたいにしぼんでいくだけだよ……忘れられて……放っておかれて……

key: I'm still sad...
en: I'm still sad...
ja: まだ悲しいままだよ……

key: Hey, did you get that Poké Doll for me?!
en: Hey, did you get that Poké Doll for me?!
ja: ねえ、あのぬいぐるみ、取ってきてくれたの?!

key: \PN handed over the Poké Doll.
en: \PN handed over the Poké Doll.
ja: \PNはポケモンのぬいぐるみを渡した。

key: Yay! You're the coolest!
en: Yay! You're the coolest!
ja: やったー! あんた最高!

key: But you know what's even COOLER?
en: But you know what's even COOLER?
ja: でも、もっと最高なものが何か分かる?

key: Ice cream!
en: Ice cream!
ja: アイスクリームだよ!

key: You know, I haven't had ice cream since my mom disappeared and--
en: You know, I haven't had ice cream since my mom disappeared and--
ja: あのね、ママがいなくなってからアイスクリーム食べてなくて――

key: LADY: There you are, sweetie, I've been looking all over for you!
en: LADY: There you are, sweetie, I've been looking all over for you!
ja: 婦人: あら、いたのね! ずっと探してたのよ!

key: KID: Umm... Hi, Mom...
en: KID: Umm... Hi, Mom...
ja: 子供: えっと……やあ、ママ……

key: It's uh... been a while.
en: It's uh... been a while.
ja: その……久しぶりだね。

key: LADY: What are you talking about? It's only been a little bit since you demanded I go off and buy the candy you wanted--
en: LADY: What are you talking about? It's only been a little bit since you demanded I go off and buy the candy you wanted--
ja: 婦人: 何言ってるの? あなたに頼まれてお菓子を買いに行ってから、まだちょっとしか経ってないでしょう――

key: Wait a second... you're acting suspicious again.
en: Wait a second... you're acting suspicious again.
ja: ちょっと待って……また怪しい様子ね。

key: KID: ...
en: KID: ...
ja: 子供: ……

key: LADY: ...Young man, what have I told you about extorting strangers?!
en: LADY: ...Young man, what have I told you about extorting strangers?!
ja: 婦人: ……坊や、知らない人からせびるのはやめなさいって、何回言ったかしら?!

key: KID: Only do it to people who look like jerks...
en: KID: Only do it to people who look like jerks...
ja: 子供: 感じ悪そうな人にしかやってないよ……

key: LADY: That's right, and this person seems like a nice respectable young Trainer-- again! That's it, you're grounded.
en: LADY: That's right, and this person seems like a nice respectable young Trainer-- again! That's it, you're grounded.
ja: 婦人: そう、それでこの人は立派で感じのいいトレーナーさんに見えるでしょう――また同じことしたのね! もう、外出禁止よ。

key: LADY: Sorry for the hassle... My son can get a little out of hand sometimes...
en: LADY: Sorry for the hassle... My son can get a little out of hand sometimes...
ja: 婦人: 面倒をかけてごめんなさいね……うちの息子、たまにちょっとやりすぎてしまって……

key: Why don't you take this as an apology?
en: Why don't you take this as an apology?
ja: おわびに、これを受け取ってくださらない?

key: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Clefairy!
en: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Clefairy!
ja: \PNはデパートステッカー「ピッピ」を手に入れた!

key: Hm... I see, so you don't have a Membership Card.
en: Hm... I see, so you don't have a Membership Card.
ja: あら……そう、会員カードをお持ちではないのね。

key: Well if you grab one from Reborn City's Department Store, I can add a Sticker to it.
en: Well if you grab one from Reborn City's Department Store, I can add a Sticker to it.
ja: リボーンシティのデパートで作ってきていただければ、ステッカーを貼ってさしあげますわ。

key: No, no, don't feel obligated... I'm okay alone, really. I should be alone because if I didn't deserve it, my parents wouldn't have died, right? I get it.
en: No, no, don't feel obligated... I'm okay alone, really. I should be alone because if I didn't deserve it, my parents wouldn't have died, right? I get it.
ja: ううん、無理しなくていいよ……ひとりで平気だから、本当に。ひとりでいるべきなんだよ、そうじゃなきゃ両親が死んだりしなかったはずだもん、でしょ? 分かってるから。

key: I feel really lonely...
en: I feel really lonely...
ja: すごく寂しいよ……

key: KID: So... no ice cream? Fine...
en: KID: So... no ice cream? Fine...
ja: 子供: つまり……アイスはなし? いいよ、別に……

key: LADY: Please, take this as an apology.
en: LADY: Please, take this as an apology.
ja: 婦人: どうぞ、おわびのしるしに。

key: LADY: Your father will hear about this.
en: LADY: Your father will hear about this.
ja: 婦人: このことはお父さんの耳にも入れておくわね。

key: SHELLY: Um, we're very sorry!
en: SHELLY: Um, we're very sorry!
ja: シェリー: あの、本当にごめんなさい!

key: It's still not safe for you to go into the city!
en: It's still not safe for you to go into the city!
ja: まだ街に入るのは安全じゃないんです!

key: Please understand, there are dangerous people there!
en: Please understand, there are dangerous people there!
ja: 危険な人たちがいるので、どうかご理解ください!

key: We'll take care of it, but in the meantime, please do your best to be patient!
en: We'll take care of it, but in the meantime, please do your best to be patient!
ja: こちらで対処しますので、それまでどうか辛抱してください!

key: Sorry, \PN!
en: Sorry, \PN!
ja: ごめんね、\PN!

key: I got caught up helping these guys handle all the traffic...
en: I got caught up helping these guys handle all the traffic...
ja: この人たちの交通整理を手伝ってて、手が離せなくなっちゃって……

key: Everyone really wants to go back to Agate now that they heard the people there are awake, but we can't let them yet!
en: Everyone really wants to go back to Agate now that they heard the people there are awake, but we can't let them yet!
ja: みんな、アゲートの人たちが目を覚ましたって聞いて戻りたがってるんだけど、まだ入れさせられないの!

key: Plus, people have been fleeing the city itself with Meteor...
en: Plus, people have been fleeing the city itself with Meteor...
ja: それに、メテオのせいで街から逃げ出してくる人たちもいて……

key: I don't think it'll be easy to get through everyone this way...
en: I don't think it'll be easy to get through everyone this way...
ja: この様子だと、みんなをかき分けて進むのは簡単じゃなさそうね……

key: Try the south entrance to Agate and I'll join you as soon as I can!
en: Try the south entrance to Agate and I'll join you as soon as I can!
ja: アゲートの南口を試してみて、できるだけ早く合流するから!

key: SHELLY: Try the south entrance to Agate and I'll join you as soon as I can!
en: SHELLY: Try the south entrance to Agate and I'll join you as soon as I can!
ja: シェリー: アゲートの南口を試してみて、できるだけ早く合流するから!

key: Why won't they let us go home now?
en: Why won't they let us go home now?
ja: なんで今になって家に帰らせてくれないんだ?

key: These stupid officers are probably the real problem here!
en: These stupid officers are probably the real problem here!
ja: この馬鹿な警備員どもが、たぶん一番の問題なんだろうな!

key: I do still have medications at home that I've needed to take...
en: I do still have medications at home that I've needed to take...
ja: 家にはまだ飲まなきゃいけない薬が置きっぱなしなんだけど……

key: Don't tell us the city's okay to go to now and then change your mind!
en: Don't tell us the city's okay to go to now and then change your mind!
ja: 街に入っていいって言っておいて、また気が変わったなんて言わないでよね!

key: Patience is a virtue often forgotten... but even I would like to return home soon.
en: Patience is a virtue often forgotten... but even I would like to return home soon.
ja: 忍耐は忘れられがちな美徳だが……わたしとて、早く家に帰りたいものだ。

key: What do you mean, Agate's not safe yet? We've been out for so long!
en: What do you mean, Agate's not safe yet? We've been out for so long!
ja: アゲートがまだ安全じゃないってどういうこと? もうずっと外にいるのに!

key: They may have slept forever in there, but it's been ages since we got to sleep in our own beds!
en: They may have slept forever in there, but it's been ages since we got to sleep in our own beds!
ja: あそこにいた人たちはずっと眠ってたかもしれないけど、こっちだって自分のベッドで寝られなくなってから、もうずいぶん経つんだから!

key: Tch, this is a fucking joke.
en: Tch, this is a fucking joke.
ja: チッ、まったくふざけた話だ。

key: First they say "Agate's awake, you can all go home."
en: First they say "Agate's awake, you can all go home."
ja: 最初は「アゲートは目を覚ましたから、みんな家に帰っていい」って言ってたのに。

key: Now they're keeping us out again?
en: Now they're keeping us out again?
ja: 今度はまた締め出すのか?

key: I'm bored...
en: I'm bored...
ja: 退屈……

key: Why did they lie about letting us go home?
en: Why did they lie about letting us go home?
ja: 帰らせてくれるって、なんでうそついたんだろう?

key: Geez, can they just let us into the city already?
en: Geez, can they just let us into the city already?
ja: まったく、もう街に入れてくれてもいいじゃないか。

key: My Pokémon are still there!
en: My Pokémon are still there!
ja: うちのポケモンがまだあそこにいるのに!

key: I just wanna be able to watch TV from home again...
en: I just wanna be able to watch TV from home again...
ja: ただ家に帰ってテレビが見たいだけなのに……

key: Aha, Trainer! You're clearly well traveled.
en: Aha, Trainer! You're clearly well traveled.
ja: ああ、トレーナーよ! 見るからに旅慣れておるな。

key: Have you come across any Shoal Shells in your journey?
en: Have you come across any Shoal Shells in your journey?
ja: 旅の道中で、あさせのかいがらに出会ったことはあるかね?

key: Send me a simple set of Shoal Shells and Shoal Salt and I shall sand such things into a Shell Bell surging with serene sounds!
en: Send me a simple set of Shoal Shells and Shoal Salt and I shall sand such things into a Shell Bell surging with serene sounds!
ja: あさせのかいがらとあさせのしおを一そろい持ってくるがいい、静かな音色を奏でるかいがらのすずに仕立て上げてみせよう!

key: Don't try saying that ten times fast though.
en: Don't try saying that ten times fast though.
ja: 早口では十回言わぬことだな。

key: Well, let's see if you have what's needed for a Shell Bell...
en: Well, let's see if you have what's needed for a Shell Bell...
ja: さて、かいがらのすずに必要なものを持っておるか見てみるとしよう……

key: So you do! What do you say?
en: So you do! What do you say?
ja: おお、持っておるな! どうする?

key: Should I make one of those ringy-thingies?
en: Should I make one of those ringy-thingies?
ja: あの鳴る道具、作ってやろうか?

key: In a snap! Just hand those here.
en: In a snap! Just hand those here.
ja: あっという間よ! それをこちらへ渡すがいい。

key: \PN handed over the materials.
en: \PN handed over the materials.
ja: \PNは材料を渡した。

key: And a click, and a tick...
en: And a click, and a tick...
ja: カチリ、コチリ……

key: And voila!
en: And voila!
ja: そして、できあがりじゃ!

key: There you go!
en: There you go!
ja: はい、どうぞ!

key: My hard work and love is in that, so guard it with your life.
en: My hard work and love is in that, so guard it with your life.
ja: わしの苦労と愛情が詰まっておる、命に代えても大事にするがいい。

key: Suit yourself, Trainer. Your loss.
en: Suit yourself, Trainer. Your loss.
ja: 好きにするがいい、トレーナーよ。お前の損だがな。

key: Not like making Shell Bells is my purpose here or anything.
en: Not like making Shell Bells is my purpose here or anything.
ja: 別に、かいがらのすずを作るのがわしの目的というわけでもないしな。

key: Hm, looks like you're missing something. Any Trainer worth their Salt should have that, you know!
en: Hm, looks like you're missing something. Any Trainer worth their Salt should have that, you know!
ja: ふむ、何か足りないもののようじゃな。腕のいいトレーナーなら塩加減くらい心得ておるものよ!

key: Hm, doesn't seem like you've got enough to Shell out, if you catch my drift.
en: Hm, doesn't seem like you've got enough to Shell out, if you catch my drift.
ja: ふむ、貝殻を出す気がないようじゃな、言いたいことは分かるだろう。

key: Well, you've got neither of them! What good are you?
en: Well, you've got neither of them! What good are you?
ja: なんじゃ、どちらも持っておらんではないか! 一体何の役に立つんじゃ?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ

key: Agate Circus
en: Agate Circus
ja: アゲートサーカス

key: Route 2
en: Route 2
ja: 2番道路
